title: Voxel's Dragons
description: This is a relatively small mod adding Dragons to your Minecraft worlds.
body:
This mod adds 4 types of Dragons which will spawn rarely across your Minecraft worlds. I plan to add more in the future. The current 4 Dragons are:



Horned Dragons: 
 Spawns on the surface of any Overworld biome. Shoots explosive fireballs.



Cave Dragons:
 Spawns underground in any Overworld biome. Shoots explosive fireballs.



Ice Dragons:
 Spawns on the surface of any snow-covered biome. Shoots Iceballs which freeze anything they hit.



Swamp Dragons:
 Spawns on the surface in Swamps and Mangrove Swamps. Shoots Poisonballs which create an AOE inflicting Poison.



All Dragon types are tamed with Dragon Feed, crafted from 5 Chorus Fruit and 4 Diamonds, resulting in 8 Dragon Feed. 



The Dragons can also be bred, which you can then feed a baby Dragon Golden Dragon Feed, which will keep it as a baby forever.



When riding a tamed Dragon, by pressing [ R ] you can shoot fireballs. 
Pressing [ TAB ] will switch between Ground travel and Air travel.
Pressing [ SPACE ] makes the Dragon jump.
